results.title: Register a new member (procedure)
results.input: CALL sp_register_member('Test.A@Example.test ', hash, 'Test A', phone, 25 y, …)
results.expected: member_id returned, code GM + 6 digits, e-mail stored lower-case and trimmed

results.title: Reject member younger than 14
results.input: sp_register_member with date of birth 10 years ago
results.expected: Error from trg_members_bi; user row rolled back
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Members must be at least 14 years old; users before/after: 117/117

results.title: Passwords are stored only as bcrypt hashes
results.expected: Every hash is 60 chars and starts with $2

results.title: Buy a membership
results.expected: Membership starts today, end date filled by trigger from plan duration, completed payment for the plan price

results.title: Renewal is queued after the current plan
results.input: Buy the same plan again for M1
results.expected: New membership starts the day after the current one ends (no overlap)

results.title: Overlapping membership is blocked
results.input: INSERT a second membership for M1 covering today
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Member already has a membership covering these dates

results.title: Inactive plan cannot be bought
results.expected: Error 'This plan is no longer offered'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 This plan is no longer offered

results.title: Freeze a membership
results.input: Member M4 buys 'Monthly Plus', then sp_freeze_membership

results.title: Frozen member cannot check in
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Membership is frozen. Unfreeze it to check in

results.title: Unfreeze adds the frozen days to the end date
results.input: Set frozen_from 5 days back, then sp_unfreeze_membership
results.expected: days_added = 5, end date +5, freeze_days_used = 5, status active

results.title: Frozen flag and frozen_from must match
results.input: UPDATE memberships SET status = 'frozen' (frozen_from stays NULL)

results.title: Payment must be for exactly one thing
results.input: INSERT payment with membership_id and pt_session_id both NULL

results.title: Payments cannot be deleted
results.input: DELETE FROM payments WHERE payment_id = <M1 payment>
results.expected: Error from trg_payments_bd 'Payments cannot be deleted; refund them instead'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Payments cannot be deleted; refund them instead

results.title: Payment details cannot be edited
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Payment details cannot be edited; refund it instead

results.title: Refund is recorded in the audit log
results.expected: Status refunded; trg_payments_au writes old/new JSON to audit_log

results.title: A refund cannot be undone
results.input: UPDATE payments SET status = 'completed' on the refunded payment
results.actual: ERROR 1644 A refunded payment cannot be restored

results.title: Check in an active member
results.expected: attendance row created, member name returned
results.actual: attendance_id 7649, name "Test A" (code typed lower-case with a space)

results.title: Double check-in is refused
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Member is already checked in

results.title: Check out
results.expected: Visit closed, minutes returned, check_out > check_in

results.title: Member without a plan cannot check in
results.expected: Error 'Member has no active membership for today'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Member has no active membership for today

results.title: Unknown member code
results.expected: Error 'No active member with that code'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 No active member with that code

results.title: Check-out before check-in is impossible
results.input: UPDATE attendance SET check_out = check_in - 1 hour

results.title: Create a class; end time filled by trigger
results.input: INSERT class_sessions (type 'Mobility & Stretch', ends_at NULL, capacity 1) on 2026-11-20 01:00

results.title: Capacity cannot exceed the room
results.input: INSERT class with capacity 13 in 'Functional Zone' (capacity 12)
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Class capacity is larger than the room capacity

results.title: Room double-booking is blocked
results.input: INSERT another class in 'Functional Zone' at the same time with another trainer
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Room is already booked for another class at that time

results.title: Trainer double-booking is blocked
results.input: INSERT a class for the same trainer at the same time in another room
results.expected: Error from sp_assert_trainer_free (called by the trigger)
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Trainer is already teaching a class at that time

results.title: Full class puts the next member on the waitlist
results.input: M2 buys 'Monthly Plus' and books C1

results.title: Same class cannot be booked twice
results.expected: Error 'You have already booked this class'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 You have already booked this class

results.title: Cancelling promotes the first waitlisted member
results.expected: M1 cancelled, M2 promoted to booked

results.title: No booking without a membership
results.actual: ERROR 1644 You need an active membership on the day of this class

results.title: Weekly class limit of the plan
results.input: New member M3 on 'Monthly Basic' (3 classes/week) books 4 classes in one week
results.actual: booked, booked, booked; then ERROR 1644 Weekly class limit of your plan reached

results.title: Cancelling a class cancels its bookings
results.input: UPDATE class_sessions SET status = 'cancelled' for C1
results.expected: trg_class_sessions_au sets every booking of C1 to cancelled

results.title: Request a PT session
results.expected: status 'requested', price 0 if the plan includes PT else the trainer's hourly rate

results.title: Trainer cannot have two sessions at once
results.input: M2 requests the same trainer at the same time
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Trainer already has a personal training session at that time

results.title: PT must be booked 2 hours ahead
results.expected: Error 'Book personal training at least 2 hours ahead'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 Book personal training at least 2 hours ahead

results.title: PT only during opening hours
results.expected: Error 'The gym is open from 06:00 to 22:00'
results.actual: ERROR 1644 The gym is open from 06:00 to 22:00

results.title: Finished PT session cannot be reopened
results.input: Set status completed, then back to 'requested'
results.expected: Error from trg_pt_sessions_bu; status change written to audit_log
results.actual: ERROR 1644 A finished or cancelled session cannot change status; audit rows for this session: 2

results.title: Expired memberships are closed
results.input: Move M5's new membership into the past, CALL sp_expire_memberships()

results.title: Finished classes are completed and absentees marked no-show
results.input: Move a booked class into the past, CALL sp_close_finished_classes()
